stories.title: Reddit deplatforming and cohort mixing in generalist Voat communities
stories.description: Deplatforming, the permanent banning of entire communities, is a common tool for content moderation on mainstream platforms. Prior research largely examines banned communities and source-platform health, leaving receiving platforms less understood. We analyze four major Reddit community bans from 2015 to 2020 and their relationship to six generalist communities on Voat, asking how users appearing on Voat after these bans are associated with community structure and toxicity. Combining network analysis, ToxiGen classifier probabilities, and dynamic reputation modeling, we document distinct trajectories in cohort mixing, structural representation, toxicity, and repeated participation across Voat’s generalist communities. Breakpoint analyses provide the clearest evidence around the GreatAwakening period in the E-I index, while mean ToxiGen classifier probability rose from approximately 0.12 in late 2015 to above 0.24 by mid-2018 and then remained elevated. Fixed-cohort results show that high-activity arrivals were more likely than average arrivals to become structurally central, and survival analyses indicate longer persistence among high early-toxicity users in earlier post-ban cohorts. These findings identify receiving-platform changes that coincided with source-platform moderation.

stories.title: Reducing the risk of overt hepatic encephalopathy recurrence
stories.description: Hepatic encephalopathy (HE) is a neurologic complication of advanced liver disease, causing impaired functioning, reduced quality of life (QOL), and increased hospitalisation and mortality. This review discusses HE burden, precipitating risk factors, and strategies to reduce overt HE (OHE) recurrence. Key precipitants include medications, constipation, dehydration, uncontrolled diabetes, electrolyte imbalances, GI bleeding, infection, and sarcopenia. Management involves education, nutritional support, pharmacotherapy, and nonpharmacologic interventions (shunt embolisation, transplantation). Guidelines recommend lactulose as secondary prophylaxis; rifaximin is added when further episodes occur. PEG and LOLA may have roles in certain patients. Investigational approaches include nitazoxanide, FMT, and AI‑based technologies.
